ShowRuneTooltip.Name: Show rune descriptions on hover
ShowRuneTooltip.Hint: Show the matching runestone description when hovering over a property-rune tag. Rune indexing and eager preparation remain unchanged when disabled.

ShowArmorRunesOnCharacterSheet.Name: Show armor runes on character sheets
ShowArmorRunesOnCharacterSheet.Hint: Show a dedicated armor-rune section on character sheets and near the NPC Armor Class field. Item-sheet and inventory tags are unaffected.

DistinguishWeaponArmorColors.Name: Use different colors for weapon and armor property runes
DistinguishWeaponArmorColors.Hint: When enabled, weapon runes are orange and armor runes are blue. When disabled, both use the same warm neutral color.
